description: Current levels of 2 to 10 US lakes side by side, read live from their gauges: elevation, feet below full pool, percent full, seasonal target and 24 h / 7 day / 30 day change, ranked by distance below full pool. A lake whose gauge is down is reported with its error instead of failing the whole call.

items.description: Lake slug from search_lakes (for example "lake-mead") or a lake name (for example "Lake Travis").

name: compare_lakes
title: Compare lake levels
